scope: Private bounded count_used reconstruction and read-only static evidence; no canonical/Git/recovery/assets/original-execution changes.

boundary_and_callers.next_entry: 0x4a30 starts a separate prologue (sub esp,8); archaeology has direct incoming call at 0x76c2 to 0x4a30.

observed_direct_callers.evidence: caller pushes EDI pool_id at 0x48b3; callee returns count in EAX; caller forms EAX-1 at 0x48b9 for reverse ordinal traversal

boundary_and_callers.index_limit: SQLite direct xrefs are verified leads; opaque indirect uses are not excluded.

semantics: One cdecl U32 pool_id argument; result is returned in EAX.
Reads starts[pool_id] and ends[pool_id] from the established g_host_pool prefix; no pool-id bounds check is present.
Walks an end-exclusive range and returns zero when start >= end.
Reads descriptor word0, increments the count when bit31 POOL_FREE is clear; pinned allocated blocks count as used.
Advances by (descriptor & 0x3fffffff) dword words, i.e. four bytes per word. No zero-descriptor guard is present.
No external/helper calls; no C runtime member identity is implicated.

arena_reinitializer_decision.context: Registered in callback slot 0x29 per evidence/host_pool_layout.json; changes saved arena/byte count, rebuilds pool0 header, calls coalesce and diagnostic.
arena_reinitializer_decision.decision: Kept out of this family. count_used is bounded by the one compact_pool direct call and depends only on already-reviewed start/end and descriptor fields; reinitializer state is not needed to determine its boundary or behavior.

source_and_prebuild.prebuild_check: region.py check allowed the new count-used-header-walk discriminator before compilation.

core_abstraction_comparison.shared_frame: Same four-byte PoolWord descriptor/owner-slot union; starts[4] at offset0 and ends[4] at offset16. Candidate uses a minimal view of this established prefix.
core_abstraction_comparison.stride_control_difference: count_used target explicitly masks descriptor with 0x3fffffff before scale-four LEA. Existing coalesce source uses cursor += descriptor; its 32-bit pointer scaling drops high flag bits modulo32. Do not transfer that unmasked source form into count_used.

fresh_candidate_build.difference_diagnosis: After diagnostic relocation resolution, only offsets 0x1 and 0x5..0x14 differ. Target keeps pool_id in ECX and zeros EAX before the two global loads; candidate uses EAX for pool_id and zeros it after loading pointers. The remaining loop, free-bit comparison, explicit low-30 mask, scale-four advance, save/restore and padding match byte-for-byte.
fresh_candidate_build.no_retry: One family/one candidate only; no type, register, spelling, or loop-form variants.

semantic_fixture.note: First fixture-only compile failed because the harness had not declared test constant POOL_PINNED; added that constant and rebuilt. The measured candidate was unchanged.

result: Function semantics and 64-byte extent are independently bounded; ordinary C candidate matches the loop/body CFG and suffix but retains an entry dataflow/register residual. No FUNCTION_MATCH or promotion.
